articles.title: Bitcoin hits $64K as gold gains while oil shakes off Trump Oman threat
articles.snippet: Bitcoin price strength saw BTC/USD pass $64,000 on 2% daily gains as gold pushed higher while US stocks wobbled on fresh US-Iran rhetoric.

articles.title: Bitmine nears 5% of Ethereum supply despite $8.4B in unrealized losses
articles.snippet: Tom Lee’s Ethereum treasury company keeps buying the second-biggest crypto through the downturn, while more than 5 million staked ETH is projected to generate $287 million in annual rewards.

articles.title: Data of 54,000 wallet users leaked, CLARITY odds just 10%: Hodler’s Digest
articles.snippet: Owners of Trezor and SafePal crypto wallets at high risk of phishing attempts after separate data leaks, CLARITY odds at 10% despite White House meeting this week.

articles.title: DefiLlama delayed mobile launch over phishing apps on Apple Store, founder says
articles.snippet: DefiLlama’s founder said Apple removed one fake app within days after the company documented it draining funds from a small crypto wallet.

articles.title: Galaxy lowers CLARITY Act odds to 10%
articles.snippet: Galaxy cited unresolved ethics, stablecoin yield and developer protection issues, along with a narrow Senate window when lawmakers return in September.
